Secure server access

Biometric + Passwordless Authentication for Linux, Windows, Databases and K8s infrastructure

AuthNull helps enable secure access to all of your infrastructure

NIST AAL2 compliant Authentication

AuthNull helps comply with some of the toughest 2FA standards - the NIST AAL2 requiring Biometric + Hardware authenticator device

Simplified setup

Add a simple script that will install an agent and you're ready to go.

Features

Support for SSH, Local (Posix) and LDAP authentication

AuthNull can enable local, or centrally managed authentication such as Active Directory with Passwordless credentials.

Enable 1FA or 2FA with backward compatbility support for SSH Keys / Passwords

AuthNull can completely eliminate passwords and SSH Keys (in many cases). However should you require for backward compatibility you can add a 2FA credential that is available through a user's authentication wallet.

Decentralized Credentials

Authnull provides decentralized credentials with W3C verified credentials format.

Vaultless authentication

The Decentralized Verified Credentials enables every user to maintain their vault of credentials on the Authenticator Wallet App. The credentials are protected by Biometric and signed using private keys owned by the user on the wallet.

Support for Local / LDAP User Authentication

AuthNull's Active Directory / LDAP Features operate with an LDAP Proxy which can delegate auth to AD while enabling 2FA passwordless + biometric


Support for Local or LDAP user authentication

Authnull enables you to have users authentication either with local privilege accounts or AD accounts with passwordless / biometric authentication.

Delegated auth to Active Directory

Authnull can provide passwordless as a factor with Delegated auth to Active directory

Active Directory Sync

Sync Active directory with an agent, a LDIF file or a CSV file import into AuthNull

Enable one or more factors of authentication

AuthNull's LDAP Proxy enables you to have one or more factors of authentication.
